name: OpenAI Realtime API
summary: OpenAI's speech-to-speech API for low-latency voice agents over WebRTC, WebSocket or SIP, with tool calling, MCP servers, interruptions and handoffs.
description: The model works directly on audio, keeps conversation state and calls tools. Typical browser flow: your server mints an ephemeral client secret (`POST /v1/realtime/client_secrets`), the frontend opens a `RealtimeSession` from the OpenAI Agents SDK (`@openai/agents/realtime`) and connects over WebRTC (`/v1/realtime/calls`); servers can connect over WebSocket. Supports voice activity detection, functions, remote MCP servers and connectors, guardrails and handoffs, plus realtime transcription. The GA interface replaced the beta (drop the `OpenAI-Beta: realtime=v1` header). Usage-based pricing per audio/text token; see OpenAI's pricing page.

agent_access.notes: Server-side OpenAI API key; browsers and mobile apps should use short-lived ephemeral client secrets.
